source_of_truth: This ledger is the only stage status tracker; stage plans describe planned work, never reported completion.

milestones.name: M0 Source and artwork baseline
milestones.criterion: Both the gameplay source candidate and full-resolution concept-art originals verified on main; image gallery displays original PNGs.

milestones.name: M1 Windows solo vertical slice
milestones.criterion: Ten seeded solo runs with real validated evidence, haunts, victory/retreat, and hands-on Windows gameplay.

milestones.name: M2 LAN 3v1 alpha
milestones.criterion: Four distinct clients finish 20 LAN matches, at least five with human ghost, without critical desync.

milestones.name: M3 Content complete
milestones.criterion: 3 classes, 13 ghosts, 9 site categories, castle, equipment, original assets, audio and rituals in game.

milestones.name: M4 Content-locked beta
milestones.criterion: Balance, accessibility, authoritative network robustness and soak acceptance; zero P0/P1.

milestones.name: M5 Windows Gold
milestones.criterion: Reproducible bundled-runtime installer, checked binary, verified download and clean-machine LAN play.

stages.title: Repository reconciliation and original-art delivery
stages.exit: Latest local nine-room gameplay build reviewed and integrated into main; real PNG files committed and displayed on the Beckenburg site.
stages.hard_gate: 100% intended sources and every gallery image remotely present and byte-verified; Windows runtime claims separately tested.
verification_evidence: Headless GameplaySmokeTest passed with javac --release 17 on OpenJDK 21 / Linux
Swing GUI menu→first-person panel passed under Linux virtual-display / xvfb; not Windows acceptance
blockers: Original full-resolution concept PNGs are not remotely verified as GitHub blobs and webpage displays placeholder SVGs
No physical/clean Windows GUI build test or bundled Windows runtime installer
Original earlier nine-room source working tree not available in this container; source was independently reimplemented and tested

steps.description: Snapshot GitHub main SHA and file hashes, local candidate sources, tests, build products and existing asset inventory.
Diff the local nine-room GameSession and menus against the committed Java prototype; inspect conflicting changes before edit.
Rerun javac --release 17 and deterministic headless tests from the clean remote baseline and from the candidate.
Merge the gameplay candidate with minimal changes, add negative-path tests, and compile from a clean worktree.
Run a real Windows GUI and input/focus test; log observed failures instead of accepting headless results as GUI proof.
Commit verified Java changes without force and read back main, key file blobs, tests and the resulting source tree.
Import all existing full-resolution concept PNGs with unique names and SHA-256 manifest; preserve originals without thumbnail substitution.
Replace SVG-only gallery references with actual committed PNGs and verify their rendered page paths and image loading.

stages.title: Java runtime boundary and 3D engine choice
stages.exit: Chosen Java 17-compatible real-time 3D renderer with explicit Swing/renderer integration boundaries.
stages.hard_gate: 50 menu/game cycles without fatal focus/resource failure; actual Windows driver/hardware proof and documented renderer decision.

steps.description: Separate simulation entities and state from Swing, Java2D renderer and UI event loop.
Benchmark existing perspective renderer, memory, frame time, resize and pitch/yaw consistency.
Prototype hardware rendering candidate and compare low-poly triangle, atlas texture and fog capabilities.
Implement a first-person walk-through test with one light, textured wall, doorway, prop and animated entity.
Test high DPI, fullscreen/windowed transitions, ALT-TAB, mouse release and swing EDT dispatch.
Declare supported GPU and Java runtime targets from observed results, not untested assumptions.
Implement engine adapter and no duplicate/hidden world-state ownership in renderer.
Validate lifecycle stress and fresh Windows startup; commit measurements and selected decision.

stages.title: Desktop menus, profiles and lobby shell
stages.exit: Real connected menu actions, ready seats and navigation, not a stack of decorative panels.
stages.hard_gate: No dead prominent button, no keyboard trap, each disabled action gives a reason.

Exercise mouse/keyboard navigation, back/escape and screen scaling at several sizes.

stages.hard_gate: Every room and door id validates; zero unreachable ritual anchor, clue socket or extraction point.

Place safe spawn/extraction, environmental hazard, object sockets, evidence sockets and ritual anchors.

Run all role sizes and both hunter and spectral traversal through every zone.

stages.title: AI ghost decisions without omniscience
stages.exit: A Spirit AI capable of genuine missions through shared commands and imperfect observations.
stages.hard_gate: AI has zero access to information beyond GhostObservation and can win/lose organically.

steps.description: Define filtered GhostObservation interface and last-known hunter position memory.
Implement seeded decision cadence, idle wandering and location/anchor preference.
Implement measured curiosity toward player noise and physical disturbance.
Generate physical evidence and ambient harassment from real command dispatcher.
Choose escalation/manifestation/hunt based on measured pressure and accessible signals.
Implement defensive response to wards, rites and failed attacks.
Prove AI code cannot read raw player inventory, journal or hidden position.
Run multiple seeded hunt/retreat cases and compare results to player ghost legal behavior.

stages.title: Three investigator disciplines and loadout mechanics
stages.exit: Cleric, Observer and Demonologist all function as differentiated roles.
stages.hard_gate: 3/3 classes complete baseline case; no class hard-lock on required universal objectives.

Add clear and compact role activity HUD including costs and tooltips.
Test all three classes against the same Spirit mission with and without ideal equipment.

stages.title: Evidence tool integration and sensor simulation
stages.exit: Working world-state-driven EMF, temperature, spirit-box, camera and auxiliary gear.
stages.hard_gate: Every required tool reading traceable to simulator cause and location, not decorative random UI.

steps.description: Implement EMF intensity from supernatural events with falloff and calibrated baseline.

Implement image/video event capture with time, camera pose and visible ghost trace.
Implement UV/residue and motion sensors through common tool event interface.
Add charge, placement, retrieval and durability to every field instrument.
Provide captions/visual feedback for all actionable audio instrument readings.
Test cause/no-cause, environment interference, cross-client and multi-instrument readings.

stages.title: Notebook, evidence inference and deception
stages.exit: Journal supports meaningful multi-channel identification with uncertainty and counterfeits.
stages.hard_gate: Each ghost has at least three distinguishable investigations; no hidden type auto-reveal in HUD.

steps.description: Define reading record schema: instrument, position, zone, time, severity, source and contamination.
Collect corroborating clues across repeated observations and assign confidence.
Implement hypothesis comparison, contradictory readings and negative tests.
Implement map heat and named zone markers without perfect ghost knowledge.
Share hunter notes to teammates while preventing ghost from seeing private entries.
Implement Mimic-compatible deliberately fake signals with falsifiable internal tells.
Prevent repeated single event from counting as independent evidence.
Run a blind test for Spirit/Poltergeist/Wraith identification and inspect misdiagnosis.

stages.title: Haunting, injury, pursuit and escape
stages.exit: Predictable escalation, dangerous but learnable ghost hunts, and recoverable injuries.
stages.hard_gate: Zero first-spawn unavoidable death, infinite stun chains or unescapable hunt traps in scripted matrix.

steps.description: Implement escalation curve from quiet haunt to warn, manifest, hunt and exhaustion.
Implement incremental injury, stress, corruption, incapacitation and rescue.
Implement hunt route, imperfect target memory and bounded chase speed.
Emit discoverable warnings before full attack and provide reliable audio/visual alternatives.
Implement protective response to temporary wards, lighting and zone-specific counters.
Allow ally stabilization, recoverable fear and controlled extraction after injury.
Ensure cooldown, damage and movement obey host state across AI/human control.
Test fresh-player survivability, repeated attack loops, door traps and failure clarity.

stages.title: Spatial rituals, séances and site cleansing
stages.exit: Fully interactive rites with spatial anchors, ghost resistance and multiple outcomes.
stages.hard_gate: 100% ritual success depends on validated world predicates, not animations; interrupted rites remain playable.

steps.description: Define ritual recipe/phase schema for zone tags, ingredients, anchors and objectives.
Implement chalk/salt/circle placement and temporary sanctified thresholds.
Implement séance with provocation, response, evidence and the ability to end safely.
Implement anchor detection, true-name/history inquiry and reagent preparation.
Implement multi-phase banishment with interruption, retry and ghost counteraction.
Implement wrong anchor, ghost or ingredient responses with recoverable consequences.
Implement final residual cleanse and mission completion on authoritative state.
Test no-anchor exploit, invalid placement, interrupted loop and human-ghost resistance.

stages.title: Playable solo mission vertical slice
stages.exit: One fully reproducible solo mission from menu to AI ghost to extraction or defeat.
stages.hard_gate: 10/10 seeded cases have valid outcome with no blocking defect and a hands-on Windows test.

steps.description: Connect mission board to room loading, selected class and equipment.
Implement Spirit haunting in the production test house with randomized legal anchor.
Require actual equipment measurements and a journal evidence conclusion.
Allow correct séance or ward/banishment attempt within active ghost counterplay.
Provide visible warning and hunt stage plus injury/retreat.
Allow successful cleansing and location extraction, including partial failure exit.
Finalize debrief, item losses and single transaction reward event.
Capture build SHA, 10 seeds, test logs and real graphical Windows playthrough.

stages.title: End-to-end 3v1 LAN alpha
stages.exit: Three hunters and human/AI Spirit complete real networked matches.
stages.hard_gate: 4 peers finish 20 test matches (>=5 human-ghost) with zero critical desync and single payouts.

steps.description: Wire four-role lobby selections and synchronized match start.

Implement ghost victory, hunter victory, extraction and failure per seat.
Handle reconnect, nonhost disconnect, match pause and host departure policies.
Test cheating client commands, ghost unfair sight and inventory duplication.
Capture multi-machine match records, packet replay and synchronized final outcomes.

stages.exit: Castle acts as persistent accessible hub and records actual expedition changes.

Profile 4-player simultaneous sound/effect scenarios against performance targets.

stages.title: User interfaces, controls and accessibility polish
stages.exit: Usable compact UI with full onboarding, in-game map, ghost HUD and remapping.
stages.hard_gate: 100% critical flows keyboard reachable and no key information encoded only by hearing or color.

steps.description: Condense castle and lobby layouts into functional information-dense menus.
Polish held-equipment HUD, interaction prompts, health, evidence journal and objective tracking.
Build ghost HUD with state, legal ability range and clear cooldown feedback.
Build floor-aware readable map, marked named zones and uncertainty overlays.
Add beginner training for each role and the ghost-player position.
Provide readable text scaling, high contrast, colorblind-safe indicators and flashing options.
Provide control rebinds, input sensitivity, camera movement/motion accommodations and sound captions.
Conduct user tests with first-time players and no outside instructions.

stages.title: Progression tuning and multiplayer competitive balance
stages.exit: Ghost/hunter outcomes and economy tuned through evidence and replay, not hidden power disparities.
stages.hard_gate: No statistically established unwinnable map/ghost/role matchup; 0 AI-versus-human powers divergences.

steps.description: Define playtest observation data that stays local unless participants explicitly opt in.
Measure time-to-clue, ghost escalation, investigation length and ritual completion by site.
Measure injured/downed/rescued/extracted players and ghost/hunter match outcomes.
Triage dominant/unplayable archetypes with enough samples to interpret confidence.
Tune observer/cleric/demonologist cooperation and solo viability.
Tune gear prices, losses, rewards and XP curves after economic simulations.
Run AI/human parity replay after each ability or combat balance edit.
Review fairness complaints against actual events and adjust telegraphs/counters.

stages.title: Performance, LAN security and long-session reliability
stages.exit: Long-play stable client/server with safe saves and bounded resource use.
stages.hard_gate: No critical security or save defect; declared hardware reaches 30 FPS min/60 FPS target; soak tests green.

steps.description: Define minimum and recommended Windows test machines, resolution and driver records.
Profile p95 frame time, 1% lows, CPU, memory and object/AI costs.
Optimize render draw calls, dynamic lights, occlusion, physics and audio work.
Soak four clients through two-hour missions and 30 repeated load/unload cycles.
Inject 0–150ms latency, 2% loss, message duplication and reconnect races.
Validate untrusted packets, limits, content IDs and save inputs; disallow unsafe deserialization.
Crash-inject during ritual, payout and local save flush and verify recovery.
Capture reproducible regression failures and root-cause fixes with post-fix proof.

stages.title: Feature freeze and closed alpha acceptance
stages.exit: Closed alpha build contains entire agreed scope under testable feature manifest.
stages.hard_gate: 0 missing release-scope systems and 0 P0; all unfinished art/models/maps remain blocking.

steps.description: Freeze scope manifest with class, ghost, map, tools, hub, rituals and LAN feature IDs.
Inspect GitHub art binary commitments, in-engine image proof and rights records.
Run full mission flow on all nine sites and with every ghost controller.
Run four-client LAN sessions with late join, disconnect, ghost swap and retreat.
Execute novice onboarding and recoverable failure/bug reproduction sessions.
Triage P0/P1/P2 bugs with reproduction and root-cause ownership.
Rerun impacted tests following every correction in bounded repair windows.
Record signed closed-alpha completion decision with actual build and test evidence.

stages.title: Beta acceptance and regression closure
stages.exit: Content-locked game across classes/ghosts/maps is stable enough for release-candidate build.
stages.hard_gate: 0 open P0/P1, 100% mandatory regression rows pass with signed omissions only after approved scope change.

steps.description: Freeze content IDs, schemas and migration before public testing.
Run entire ghost-by-role-by-site compatibility matrix and mimic/twins edge cases.
Run clean-install Windows GUI, sound, input and graphics setting checks.
Run network reconnect, profile save and payment-once regression suite.
Fix every P0/P1 at source and verify impacted cross-feature paths.
Retest accessibility, captioning, quest map readability and tutorial completion.
Gather and interpret beta session stability, fairness and performance results.
Archive beta sign-off, trace captures, defects and regression evidence.

stages.title: Release candidate, Windows installer and support docs
stages.exit: Clean-machine installable Windows product with complete documentation and executable evidence.
stages.hard_gate: 100% required clean-machine paths pass; 0 open P0/P1; exact installer hashes recorded and read back.

steps.description: Build from clean main checkout with pinned Java 17 target and asset manifest.
Package bundled-runtime Windows installer/ZIP without requiring developer JDK.
Record commit/version/build ID, file size, content license list and SHA-256.
Install, start, host LAN, join ghost and three hunters, play and finish a mission on clean PCs.
Verify profile persistence, downgrade/reinstall behavior and clean uninstall.
Test graphics switching, focus handling, DPI, accessibility, missing-audio and corrupt config.
Publish complete key map, host/join instructions, troubleshooting and known issues.
Redownload RC candidate and compare hash, then sign release readiness.

stages.title: Gold release and postrelease maintenance
stages.exit: Verified Windows production release, source/tag/assets and reproducible evidence.
stages.hard_gate: Verified published binary and complete LAN clean-machine test with 0 P0/P1; no fake completion from successful commit alone.

steps.description: Conduct formal go/no-go based on signed gates and product-scope requirements.
Create versioned release tag at verified default branch SHA.
Publish final Windows installer/ZIP and accurate system requirements, release notes and licensing.
Read back published asset, exact size and SHA-256 against source package.
Test downloaded product on a clean supported Windows machine, including LAN match and saves.
Publish known issues, crash-log instructions, accessibility notes and support contact.
Define emergency patch criteria, compatibility rules and main-branch-only recovery approach.
Keep archived release verification, artifacts and measured metrics for future maintenance.
